blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—No bettor won the jackpots in the Ultra Lotto 6/58 and Super Lotto 6/49 draws on Sunday, Sept. 27, according to results provided by the Philippine Charity Sweepstakes Office. The Ultra Lotto 6/58 winning combination was 57-40-09-54-56-27 for a jackpot of ₱337.82 million. No ticket matched all six numbers. The Super Lotto 6/49 winning combination was 09-10-41-38-08-26 for a jackpot of ₱25.46 million. No ticket matched all six numbers.
